               Commencement of PG Classes – Academic Session 2026–27
        This is to inform all the Post Graduate (PG) students of all departments of Mangaldai College (Autonomous) that the
PG classes for the Academic Session 2026–27 will commence from 18 th August, 2026 (Tuesday).
        All PG students are requested to attend the classes regularly from the date of commencement and follow the academic
instructions issued by the College from time to time.
Common WhatsApp Group for PG Students
        A common WhatsApp group for all PG students will be created by the Academic Council, Mangaldai College
(Autonomous) for communicating important academic and administrative information.
         The common WhatsApp Group link and the official WhatsApp Channel link will be communicated to the students
          through their registered e-mail IDs.
         Individual departments may also create and maintain separate departmental WhatsApp groups for PG students for
          department-specific academic communication.
         Students are advised to regularly check their e-mail and join the official WhatsApp group and channel immediately after
          receiving the links.
         Students can collect their Uniform Badge from the Administrative Office, Mangaldai College (Autonomous)
         For ID-Card, online application link will be available in the WhatsApp Group.
    Receipt of Admission
    The admission receipt will be provided to the students shortly through their registered e-mail ID or, where necessary,
    physically at college.
    Uniform for PG Students
    All PG students of Mangaldai College (Autonomous) shall follow the prescribed College uniform. Click here to see the Dummy
    Uniform https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZZK5Ig-OBl_Wl8PMgDyuwCOvc5hM2nF0/view
    For Female Students:
    White Kurta/Salwar with the prescribed pink printed Dupatta.
    For Male Students:
    White full-sleeve formal shirt with grey formal trousers and black formal shoes.
    Students are advised to maintain proper discipline and wear the prescribed uniform while attending College. All concerned
    students are requested to take note of the above instructions and extend their cooperation for the smooth commencement of
    the new academic session.
